en: n. the good feeling you get when you have achieved something or got what you wanted; something that gives you this feeling; the act of making someone feel pleased; compensation for a wrong
ex: She felt great satisfaction after finishing the project.
完成專案後，她感到非常滿足。

en: adv. almost not; only just; hardly ever; used to say that something happened immediately after something else
ex: I could scarcely believe my eyes when I saw the gift.
看到那份禮物時我幾乎不敢相信自己的眼睛。

en: vt. to rub your skin or a surface with something sharp; to cut the surface of something lightly; to remove something by rubbing; n. a mark or cut made by something sharp; a small injury; the sound made by scratching
ex: The cat scratched the sofa with its claws.
貓用爪子抓了沙發。

en: n. the art of making figures from stone, wood, metal or clay; a figure or object made in this way; vt. to make something into a sculpture; vi. to make sculptures
ex: The museum has a famous sculpture by Rodin.
博物館有一座羅丹的著名雕塑作品。

en: a. safe from harm or danger; free from worry or fear; firmly fixed; vt. to get something that you want with difficulty; to make something safe; to fasten something firmly
ex: Please make sure the door is secure before you leave.
離開前請確定門已鎖緊。

en: vt. to join things together using a needle and thread; to make or repair clothes with a needle and thread; vi. to make stitches with a needle and thread
ex: She sewed a button back onto her coat.
她把一顆鈕扣重新縫回外套上。

en: n. an area where light is blocked and it is cooler; something that is used to cover a light or window; a particular type of a color; a small amount of difference; vt. to protect something from light; vi. to change gradually from one color to another
ex: We sat in the shade of a big tree.
我們坐在大樹的樹蔭下。

en: a. protected from the sun by trees or buildings; seeming to be dishonest or illegal; (of a person) not to be trusted; hidden
ex: We had lunch in a shady spot by the river.
我們在河邊一處樹蔭下吃午餐。

en: a. so bad that people should feel ashamed; causing someone to feel embarrassed; morally wrong or offensive
ex: It is shameful to cheat on an exam.
考試作弊是可恥的。

en: n. a place where you are protected from bad weather or danger; protection from danger or bad weather; vt. to protect someone or something from bad weather or danger; vi. to take cover from rain or danger
ex: They took shelter from the rain under a tree.
他們在樹下躲雨。

en: n. a change in position, direction or attitude; a period of work at a factory; a group of workers who work during the same period; vt. to move something from one place to another; to change something; vi. to move or change position
ex: He works the night shift at the hospital.
他在醫院上夜班。

en: n. the activity of visiting famous places as a tourist; a. relating to the activity of visiting famous places
ex: We spent the whole day sightseeing in Rome.
我們整天都在羅馬觀光。

en: n. your name written in your own way; a distinctive mark or characteristic; the sharps or flats at the beginning of a piece of music; a. (of a product) typical of a person or company
ex: Please put your signature at the bottom of the form.
請在表格底部簽名。

en: n. the form of a word that refers to one person or thing; a. referring to only one person or thing; very unusual or strange; extraordinary
ex: The word "child" is singular, and "children" is plural.
「child」是單數，「children」是複數。

en: n. a place where something is, was or will be; a piece of land used for a particular purpose; a website; vt. to put something in a particular place
ex: The construction site is closed to the public.
工地不對外開放。

en: n. a quick, simple drawing that does not have many details; a short description or outline; a short funny scene; v. to make a quick, rough drawing; to describe something briefly
ex: She made a quick sketch of the landscape.
她快速畫了一張風景素描。

en: n. a very tall building in a city; a tall office or apartment tower with many floors
ex: The city skyline is full of glass skyscrapers.
這座城市的天際線布滿了玻璃帷幕摩天大樓。

en: n. a place on a wall where you can connect electrical equipment; a hollow place where something fits; the part of the body where a bone or an eye fits; vt. to insert something into a socket
ex: Plug the charger into the wall socket.
把充電器插到牆上的插座。

en: n. the programs and instructions that tell a computer what to do; computer programs in general
ex: You need to install the software before using the device.
使用裝置前需要先安裝軟體。

en: a. extra; not being used; kept in case you need it; (of time) free; vt. to avoid using or hurting something; to give something that you can do without; n. an extra thing kept for emergencies
ex: I always keep a spare key under the doormat.
我總是把備用鑰匙放在門墊下。

en: n. a long pole with a sharp point used as a weapon in ancient times; a young shoot of a plant, such as asparagus; vt. to stab or pierce something with a spear; vi. to stab or thrust with a spear
ex: The hunters used spears to catch fish.
獵人用矛來捕魚。

en: a. very good or beautiful; excellent; very impressive; having great beauty or richness
ex: We had a splendid view of the mountains.
我們有一個絕佳的山景視野。

en: vt. to push a knife into someone or something; to push something sharp into something; n. an act of stabbing someone; a sudden sharp pain; an attempt to do something
ex: He was stabbed in the arm during the fight.
他在打鬥中被刺傷了手臂。

en: n. numbers that show information about something; the science of collecting and analyzing numbers; a. relating to statistics
ex: The statistics show that crime has fallen this year.
統計數字顯示今年犯罪率下降了。

en: n. the legal position of a person or group; the level of importance or respect that someone has in society; the current state of something; a person's position in a group
ex: Her marital status is single.
她的婚姻狀況是單身。

en: a. unwilling to spend money; mean with money or time; (of an amount) very small; having a sting
ex: He is too stingy to buy a gift for his own mother.
他吝嗇到連自己的母親都不買禮物。

en: n. a sudden serious illness caused by a blockage in the brain; a single movement of a pen or brush; a hit; a gentle touch with the hand; vt. to rub something gently with your hand; to row a boat
ex: He had a stroke and could no longer speak clearly.
他中風了，說話不再清晰。

en: n. a ship that can travel under the water; a. living or used under the sea; vt. to attack a ship using a submarine
ex: The submarine dived to a depth of two hundred meters.
潛水艇潛到兩百公尺深。

en: n. an idea or plan that you offer for other people to consider; a thought that someone puts into your mind; a slight sign of something
ex: Do you have any suggestions for improving the service?
對於改善服務，你有任何建議嗎？

en: n. everything that is around you; the place and conditions in which you live; the area around a place
ex: The hotel is set in beautiful surroundings.
這間飯店坐落在優美的環境中。

en: a. making you feel that something is wrong or illegal; not trusting someone or something; showing that you do not trust someone
ex: The police noticed a suspicious package near the entrance.
警方注意到入口附近有一個可疑的包裹。

en: n. a system of sending messages over long distances by using electrical signals along wires; a message sent by this system; vt. to send a message by telegraph; vi. to send a telegraph message
ex: The news came by telegraph in the nineteenth century.
十九世紀時，消息是靠電報傳來的。

en: n. something that a person or thing is likely to do; a natural liking for something; the way in which something changes or develops
ex: He has a tendency to talk too much.
他有說太多話的傾向。

en: n. a feeling of worry that makes it difficult to relax; a situation in which people or groups do not trust each other; the state of being stretched tight; vt. to stretch something tightly
ex: There is a lot of tension between the two countries.
兩國之間有許多緊張關係。

en: a. complete and careful; including all the details; done very carefully; (of a person) very careful and paying attention to details
ex: The police made a thorough search of the house.
警方對這棟房子進行了徹底的搜查。

en: n. the willingness to accept other people's behavior and opinions; the ability to bear something unpleasant; the amount by which a measurement can vary; the ability of the body to resist a drug
ex: We should show tolerance towards people of different religions.
我們應該對不同宗教的人表現出包容。

en: vt. to allow something to happen without trying to stop it; to accept someone or something that is not completely satisfactory; to be able to bear something unpleasant; to be able to survive in particular conditions
ex: I can't tolerate rude behavior.
我無法容忍無禮的行為。

en: n. a large stone structure above or below ground where a dead person is buried; a place where a body is buried; death; vt. to bury something in a tomb
ex: The tomb of the ancient king was discovered in the desert.
古代國王的陵墓在沙漠中被發現。
ph: the tomb of the unknown soldier

en: n. a person who changes written words from one language to another
ex: The translator spent two years translating the novel into English.
譯者花了兩年把這本小說翻成英文。

en: n. the system of vehicles such as buses and trains used to move people; the act of moving people or goods from one place to another; a vehicle used for travel
ex: Public transportation in the city is cheap and convenient.
這座城市的大眾運輸便宜又方便。
